title: two thread templates in the embedded prj tree are rendered by nothing and read only by a pin test
body:
Found by cc's templates audit on 2026-09-24 for the 3.2.1 doc audit.

Seen: `lib/templates/prj/st/ST####/info.md` and `lib/templates/prj/st/WP/info.md` are rendered by nothing -- `intent init` skips them (`init.rs:132-133`) -- and are read only by `intentsvcs/tests/template_pins.rs:52-65`, whose header declares them frozen v2 files. They sit in an embedded, compiled-in template tree.

Expected: the template tree holds only what something renders, or says why a file is kept.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- kept for 3.2.1, on cc's recommendation, because deleting them means changing `init.rs` and two pin tests in a stabilisation release; filed for Triage after the line.


Fixed in 3.2.2 by `d71bc739b` (vc, 2026-09-25): the commit message names the bank, its patch-id and the judge.
